name: MClean Technologies Berhad
overview: 2026年，MClean Technologies Berhad 的公告主要涉及资本运作，包括免费发行凭单、私下配售新股和拟回购股份，未披露各业务板块的产能、合约或市场扩张等具体运营变化。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长14.2%，净利润同比增长36.3%。
overview_en: no specific operational changes such as capacity expansion, contracts, or market expansion for its business segments were disclosed. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 14.2% year-on-year and net profit grew 36.3% year-on-year.
